summary: SpyGlass Pharma filed an 8-K on October 1, 2026, announcing its acquisition of 100% of Advanced Vision Science, Inc. from Santen Holdings US, Inc., with Santen Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd. guaranteeing the seller's obligations. Consideration was $13,000,000 cash, subject to customary post-closing adjustments. AVS previously supplied SpyGlass with intraocular lenses. Ancillary agreements include an amended supply and distribution pact granting Santen exclusive Japan sales rights to Eternity lenses and cross-licenses of intellectual property. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. The all-cash deal closed simultaneously with signing, eliminating financing and regulatory-approval risk.
